lines.zh: 我小跑在熔岩丘的坡上
lines.en: I trot on the slopes of the molten hills
My six little legs move quickly

lines.zh: 脚底有硬壳，烫的地面也不怕
lines.en: My soles are shelled, the hot ground does not bother me

lines.zh: 我跟在大的后面，走一截停一截
lines.en: I follow the big ones and stop every few steps
Volcanic ash feels soft underfoot

lines.zh: 热风把我的触角吹歪了
lines.en: The hot wind bends my antennae
I go around the cracks, they glow red
I am still small and cannot go fast
The stones on the ground are warm
I take two steps and look back at you

lines.zh: 熔岩丘上没有草，只有石头
lines.en: There is no grass on the molten hills, only stone
I find a gap and slip through
My tail is short and flicks quickly
I walk in the big ones' prints

lines.zh: 空气是热的，我呼吸也变得急
lines.en: The air is hot, my breathing gets quick

lines.zh: 我沿着一道冷下去的石坎走
lines.en: I follow a stone ledge that has cooled
I crouch on a stone and look below
My antennae never stop moving
The air here smells of sulfur
I am still small, my shell still soft
I hear something moving under the ground
The hot wind keeps my eyes shut
I tuck into a crack, it is warm

lines.zh: 我的腿有六条，走路要协调
lines.en: Six legs need coordinating
There is light far off, lava
I am waiting for the big ones to return

lines.zh: 我舔了舔石头上的水汽
lines.en: I lick the moisture off a stone
There is not much to eat here

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，和我一样高
lines.en: You crouched, now you are my height

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在你脸上找东西
lines.en: My eyes are searching your face

lines.zh: 我不怕你，可我得先看看
lines.en: I am not afraid, but I must look first
I raise my head, antennae toward you
Your hands really are enormous
You touched the stones, your hands are warm
When I move, my shell clicks
I made half a circle at your feet
You reached out, I stepped back half a pace

lines.zh: 我饿了，可我不确定你是不是吃的
lines.en: I am hungry, but I am not sure you are food
Do not step on my tail
I turn my shell mouth out and draw in
A pale mark on my shell
I rolled half a turn, six feet up
Something this small can hurt too
I make a very thin sound
I press myself flatter to the ground
One leg has gone numb
The hot stone burns the sore spot
I am small, I cannot take blows
That one is enough
What have you got there
I come close to sniff and pull back
It does not smell like stone
It will not give, too hard
I look up at you, is there more

lines.zh: 你放到石头上，我自己来
lines.en: Put it on the stone and let me get it
I am small, I cannot eat that much
The hot wind scatters the smell
Keep your hand still, I am a little afraid

lines.zh: 我把它顶在头上，走了两步
lines.en: I balance it on my head and walk two steps
I will keep this piece and eat it slowly
One nudge and I rolled over

lines.zh: 我六条腿乱蹬，站起来了
lines.en: My six legs scrambled and I stood

lines.zh: 你这么重，我只是个小东西
lines.en: You are so heavy, I am only a small thing
I curl up, shell outward

lines.zh: 你的脚压到我的触角了。
lines.en: Your foot is pinning my antenna.

lines.zh: 我往石缝里钻，钻不进去
lines.en: I try to squeeze into the crack and cannot

lines.zh: 这一下，我的触角折了一根
lines.en: That bent one of my antennae
I backed a long way before stopping
The stone is hot and so are my feet
Touch again and I run
I am too small for that
My shell has not hardened yet
There are not many of my kind on the molten hills
The big ones do not let me join
I wait on this stone
Everyone avoids the hot places
Ask again when the shell is hard
First I must learn not to burn my feet
This is not the place for that
Stand back, do not get burned
I clamp it with both forelegs
Heavier than I can haul
I roll it twice
I look up, wanting to give it to you

lines.zh: 这东西在石头上很显眼
lines.en: This stands out on the stone

lines.zh: 我叼着，走了三步就掉了
lines.en: I carry it three steps and drop it
It will not fit in the crack
I push it to the side
It rolled down the slope
A shadow is coming from above
I lift my head, antennae up
I shift toward the rock crack
The big ones are not here
All six legs are tensed
You stand on the slope, I cannot see clearly
Something crunched gravel
I retreat behind the stone

lines.zh: 热风把那边的味道带过来了
lines.en: The hot wind carries a scent this way
I am small and slow
I heard it, it is close
I hear stones rolling

lines.zh: 坡上有个大影子，不是我的同类
lines.en: A big shadow on the slope, not one of mine
I shift two steps down the slope
That thing has not gone
I press into the crack and stay still
The molten hills are full of cracks to hide in

lines.zh: 我的颜色和石头差不多
lines.en: My color is close to the stone
When it moves, I shrink deeper

lines.zh: 这里的石头是热的，躲久了烫
lines.en: The stone here is hot, hiding too long burns
I will wait here a while
It has circled round from there

lines.zh: 我的触角能感觉到震动
lines.en: My antennae can feel the vibration
Closer and I run downhill

lines.zh: 我躲在一块石头后面，只露触角
lines.en: I hide behind a stone, only my antennae showing

lines.zh: 它在坡上走，我在坡下看
lines.en: It walks the upper slope, I watch from below

lines.zh: 石头一滚就有声，我不动
lines.en: Rolling stones make noise, so I stay still
My legs stay ready
That was light, I am too small
I bit, my teeth are not hard
I push with all six legs
My shell nearly knocked you
I lower my head and push
That one flipped me first
I hop once and land beside you
You did not even bother to move
Then I retreat into the crack

lines.zh: 熔岩丘的石缝里多了个影子
lines.en: A shape has appeared in a crack on the molten hills
I struggle free of the shell
The ash on the stone is moving
My six legs have just found their footing
The hot wind makes me wobble
One of the big ones is right nearby
I poke my head out of the crack

lines.zh: 这里没有草，只有石头和热
lines.en: No grass here, only stone and heat
I shake the ash off my shell
I landed very lightly
The fire made me pull in tight

lines.zh: 我从石头上滚下去，壳先着地
lines.en: I rolled off the stone, shell first

lines.zh: 水比熔岩可怕，我喘不上气
lines.en: Water is worse than lava, I cannot breathe
The blast threw me far

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在石头上，碎石打到我
lines.en: An arrow hit the stone and the chips struck me

lines.zh: 冷气从缝里挤进来，我打了个颤
lines.en: Cold squeezed in through a seam and I shuddered

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，我饿得没力
lines.en: Nothing here, hunger has drained me

lines.zh: 雷打在丘顶，我整只都僵了
lines.en: Lightning struck the hilltop and I went stiff

lines.zh: 这里没有石头，我抓不住
lines.en: No stone here, nothing to grip
